description: Create a new managed QR code with optional custom styling. The QR code points to a short URL that redirects to your target URL. You can change the target URL later without regenerating the QR image. Supports custom colors, dot shapes, corner shapes, and logo embedding.

background_color.description: Hex color for QR code background. Default: #ffffff (white).

corner_style.description: Shape of finder patterns (corner squares). square=classic, extra-rounded=smooth, dot=circular.

dot_style.description: Shape of data modules. square=classic, rounded=soft corners, dots=circles, classy-rounded=organic.

error_correction.description: Error correction level. L=7%, M=15% (default), Q=25%, H=30%. Auto-set to H when logo is provided.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time. After this date, scanning returns 410 Gone instead of redirecting.

foreground_color.description: Hex color for QR code dots. Default: #000000 (black).

format.description: Image format. "svg" is recommended (smaller, scalable, text-parseable). Use "png" only if a bitmap is required.

frame_border_radius.description: Frame corner radius. Only for 'rounded' style.

frame_color.description: Hex color for frame background. Default: #000000.

frame_style.description: Decorative frame around QR. 'banner_bottom': text below, 'banner_top': text above, 'rounded': rounded border with text.

frame_text.description: CTA text on the frame (e.g. 'Scan Me!', 'View Menu'). Max 30 chars. Requires frame_style.

frame_text_color.description: Hex color for frame text. Default: #ffffff.

gradient.description: Apply a gradient to QR dots and corners instead of solid foreground_color.

gtm_container_id.description: Google Tag Manager container ID (e.g. 'GTM-ABC123'). Enables GTM tracking on QR scans via an intermediate HTML page.

label.description: An optional label to identify this QR code.

logo_size.description: Logo size as ratio of QR width (0.15-0.3). Default: 0.2.

logo_url.description: URL to a logo image (PNG/JPG/SVG) or data:base64 URI. Centered on the QR code.

margin.description: Quiet zone margin in modules. Default: 2.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time when target automatically switches to scheduled_url.

scheduled_url.description: Replacement URL that activates at scheduled_at.

target_url.description: The destination URL the QR code should redirect to.

width.description: QR code width in pixels. Default: 400.

name: create_qr_code
